q: “Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of…”
opts: The Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost

q: “If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to…”
exp: To cleanse us from all unrighteousness. (1 John 1:9)

q: In the story of the lost son, what did the father do when his son came home?
opts: Ran and hugged him and had a party
exp: His father… ran, and fell on his neck, and kissed him. (Luke 15:20)

q: Jesus said “I am the way, the truth, and the life”. What comes next?
opts: No man cometh unto the Father, but by me
exp: No man cometh unto the Father, but by me. (John 14:6)

q: Peter and John healed a lame man at the temple gate. What did the man do?
opts: Walked and leaped and praised God
exp: He leaping up stood, and walked… walking, and leaping, and praising God. (Acts 3:8)

q: Jesus said it is easier for what animal to go through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter God's kingdom?
exp: It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle. (Matthew 19:24)

q: Psalm 22 begins with words Jesus cried on the cross. Which?
opts: Into thy hands I commend my spirit
My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?
exp: Psalm 22:1; Jesus cried these words in Matthew 27:46.

q: What did Jesus say when His disciples tried to send children away?
opts: Suffer little children to come unto me
exp: Suffer little children… to come unto me. (Matthew 19:14)

q: “For the wages of sin is death; but the gift of God is…”
opts: Eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord
exp: Eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord. (Romans 6:23)

q: What happened to the veil of the temple when Jesus died?
opts: It fell to the ground whole
It was torn in two from top to bottom
exp: The veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom. (Matthew 27:51)

q: What is the greatest commandment, according to Jesus?
opts: Love the Lord thy God with all thy heart
exp: This is the first and great commandment. (Matthew 22:37–38)

q: Which woman from Canaan said even the dogs eat the crumbs from the master's table?
exp: Yet the dogs under the table eat of the children's crumbs. (Mark 7:26–28)

q: “If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to…”
exp: To cleanse us from all unrighteousness. (1 John 1:9)
